plan: [This is a second-price (Vickrey) sealed-bid auction with independent private values. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy: you win whenever the highest competing value is below yours and you pay the second-highest bid, so bidding your true value maximizes expected surplus and avoids profitable deviations. The other rational bidders will likewise bid their values. I will bid my true value of $35.]
